column1: # Step 1 site preference. Source: db/properties/site_preference_raw_78.csv (78 systems).
# ** The three points per element are three DOPING LEVELS (labels x002 / x005 / x010)
#   The old slide caption said 'spread across our three runs' - that was wrong (fixed 2026-08-18).
# ** DO NOT read the labels as x = 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.10. ** They are folder labels
#   Y2O3_x005 = 2 Y in a 47-atom cell = 4.3 at% of the cell = 33% of the P sites.
#   A DIFFERENT campaign (cascade multi_category_v23) reused the same x002/x005/x010 labels while
#   actual_x was 0.25 for all three - that series was voided (hard_dopant_handling_protocol.md).
#   This one is NOT that: 25 of 26 elements give three DISTINCT dE values (median spread 1.53 eV)
#   so the three points really are three different loadings.
#   So a bar crossing zero is not scatter: the preferred site actually changes with x.
# dE = [E(M@P) - E(M@Li)] / n_dopant.  dE<0 -> P framework
# unconverged_x lists doping levels whose relaxation did not converge (kept in the plot
